headline: LAD @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.69 at SDP 3.61, with a projected total of 8.30. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: LAD moved +0.53 runs while SDP moved +0.02, changing the projected margin by +0.51 runs. The projected total climbed +0.55, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Yoshinobu Yamamoto has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Samad Taylor, Freddie Freeman, Mookie Betts, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Dalton Rushing, Ryan Ward because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
